site.intro.en.text:
I turn audience insight into creative that converts — and build AI tools to do it faster.
translate performance data into creative insights that inform iterations and new concepts

nodes.xbox-launch.summary.en.text: I led the creative strategy for Genshin Impact’s Xbox launch campaign across the US, France and Germany. The campaign delivered 120M+ impressions and lifted CTR by 338% against the earlier benchmark.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.0.items.0.en.text: The launch needed paid media to drive traffic to the Xbox landing page, not just awareness. That meant turning existing brand materials into 100+ localized assets, our team’s largest creative test for a paid brand campaign, with tight coordination across languages, platform specs and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Defined the creative strategy: Used past campaign learnings and regional player insights to build four testable creative concepts, adapted for US, French and German audiences.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Managed creative production: Wrote briefs covering copy, landing-page links and platform specs for all 144 assets, and kept timelines, reviews and approvals on track.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Supported media optimization: Helped shape budget, regional priorities and targeting across YouTube, Meta, X and TikTok, then reviewed live results with the media team to scale winners and pause underperformers.

nodes.xbox-launch.results.1.en.text: lower CPC versus the earlier benchmark

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.summary.en.text: I led the brand team's creative strategy for Genshin Impact's user acquisition, building a creator-led ad pipeline across Japan, North America and Europe. Our creatives delivered ~3.7× projected LTV and 26% higher projected 365-day ROI than the UA benchmark.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: The UA team's tests showed creator ads scaled and converted well, but they couldn't produce enough of them. The brand team had creator resources but had never worked on user acquisition.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Built and evolved the testing framework: Translated acquisition goals into market-specific creative hypotheses, using performance data to steer tests across hooks, creative angles, scripts and formats.
Directed creator production: Briefed creators, developed script templates and reviewed every video before launch.

Built the AI Creative Intelligence Dashboard: Vibe-coded a tool that automates creative tagging and performance analysis, surfaces winning patterns, and turns them into reusable scripts and playbooks.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.label.en.text: Zenless Zone Zero: Social Launch in Japan

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.summary.en.text: I scaled an early network of social channels for Zenless Zone Zero in Japan to 9 channels and 80M+ organic views, while cutting cost per view by more than 50%.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.0.items.0.text: I was on the Genshin Impact brand team, which had experience growing social channels, so the Zenless Zone Zero team asked us to launch its Japanese channels and hand them over once they could run on their own. There was little precedent for growing channels like these in Japan, so I had to learn the market while testing what worked, then turn scattered experiments into a system the Zenless Zone Zero team could take over, all within a limited timeframe.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.team.en.text: Me (creative strategy, brand team), 1 UA strategist, 1 UA specialist and 4 agency partners. The UA team owned media buying and budget; I owned creative strategy and production.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.team.en.text: Me (social strategy), 2 content reviewers and 3 agency partners

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.0.text: Defined the channel strategy: Researched Japanese player behavior, competitor channels and content gaps to match each channel to a niche with proven demand and room to grow, with clear content pillars across YouTube and X.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.1.text: Ran biweekly growth reviews: Tracked every channel against its KPIs, diagnosed the ones falling behind and stepped in to redirect them.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.2.text: Managed agency partners: Coordinated three agencies, aligning briefs, reviews and performance targets to lift content quality and cost efficiency.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Handed over a self-running system: Codified content learnings, KPIs and routines into playbooks, and transferred all nine channels to the Zenless Zone Zero team.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Strengthened creator sourcing: Expanded regional talent pools through agency pitches and rotation, matching creators to the formats they perform best.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: I had to build the Brand-to-UA pipeline from scratch and prove, within a few game updates, that our creatives could earn spend and bring in quality players, not just add volume. The budget only covered smaller creators, so the content itself had to do the work.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Adapted winning formats: Identified the formats driving growth in each niche and brought them to stalled channels to restart growth.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.results.added-2f6c.text: Channels hitting view targets at handover

nodes.gip-testing.summary.en.text: I designed and ran a three-round testing framework to see whether TikTok’s UGC incentive program could boost installs efficiently.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Designed the test framework: Built a three-round roadmap, setting each round’s payout model (CPM or CPA), markets, themes, budgets and success metrics against our UA benchmarks.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Led campaign execution: Owned all three rounds end to end, from task setup and creator briefs to progress tracking, submission reviews and recaps.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Raised content quality: Optimized creator task briefing, and flagged off-brief videos to free up the prize pool for better ones.

nodes.gip-testing.sections.1.items.3.en.text: Evaluated performance and drove the decision: Measured reach, CPI, user quality and content relevance against our UA benchmarks, then recommended stopping the program and shifting budget to creator ads for UA.

nodes.xbox-launch.team.en.text: Me (creative strategy), 1 media strategist, 2 creative producers and 1 agency partner

nodes.influencer-activation.summary.en.text: I owned the creator strategy for a flagship Genshin Impact character launch on X. The campaign delivered 13M+ views at 8%+ engagement, about 3x the previous creator campaign at 39% lower CPM.

nodes.influencer-activation.sections.1.i.text: Rebuilt the creator strategy: Shifted spend from broad-appeal creators to the artists, cosplayers, streamers and Genshin news creators that core players follow, so 80% of the lineup reached core players. I also grew English-language creators to half the lineup and briefed a US agency on art styles local players respond to.

Led execution and benchmarking: Managed budget, creator sourcing, timelines and approvals with two agencies, then benchmarked results against the previous creator campaign to decide what to scale next.

nodes.genshin-en-accounts.summary.en.text: I helped grow a network of 8 English-language Genshin Impact channels on TikTok and YouTube, refreshing the strategy for channels that had plateaued and building it from scratch for new ones. Together they drew 35M+ views and 64K+ new followers at about 30% below target CPM.

nodes.genshin-en-accounts.sections.1.ite.text: Diagnosed what stalled growth: Used Tubular and monthly reports to compare TikTok trends, competitor channels and each channel’s performance, and pinpointed the gaps: too few evergreen topics, stale formats and weak follower conversion.

Refreshed the content mix: Turned the findings into changes for each channel. Guide channels that leaned on time-sensitive patch tutorials added short, entertaining gameplay tips and varied their covers, so views no longer depended on update days.

Built strategy for the new channels: Defined each channel’s audience, positioning, content pillars, formats and posting cadence from platform research and competitor benchmarks, then refined them on early performance data before scaling production.
Ran monthly reviews: Tracked KPIs, reviewed English content and kept the agency’s output aligned with each channel’s growth goals.

nodes.giveaway-campaign.summary.en.text: For a major Genshin Impact update, I led a giveaway with the biggest Genshin fan account on X, backed by 67 creators across X, TikTok and Instagram, to reach players beyond official channels. It drew 33M+ impressions and about 900K in-game code redemptions, 4x the goal.

nodes.giveaway-campaign.sections.1.items.text: Designed the campaign: Partnered with the biggest Genshin fan account on X (1M+ followers). To enter, players quote-posted the giveaway with their own creative take, and in-game reward codes turned views into a measurable action.
Activated creators across platforms: Coordinated 67 creators across X, TikTok and Instagram, who posted their own entries first to show players how to join.

Led execution and the recap: Aligned four agencies on briefs, content review, timelines and tracking. Code redemptions beat the goal, but fewer players entered the giveaway itself because quote-posting a creative entry took too much effort on X. The lesson: giveaways run with fan accounts need one-tap actions, like a repost or a reply.

nodes.influencer-activation.results.3.en.text: Event exposure vs a comparable launch

nodes.influencer-activation.sections.0.i.text: For a major character launch, I needed to refocus creators on core players and drive them to the official X event and its in-game reward codes.

Engagement on Genshin Impact’s recurring character campaigns on X was flattening, and it was weakest among English-speaking players. Our previous creator campaign aimed for broad appeal: many of its creators reached general gaming audiences rather than core Genshin players, so it brought reach but under 3% engagement.

nodes.interactive-filter.summary.en.text: I helped create two AR filters for Lantern Rite, Genshin Impact’s annual Lunar New Year event, and activated 70+ creators to show players how to use them, as the campaign expanded from TikTok to Snapchat for the first time. It drew 600M+ views and 600K+ player videos, and the Snapchat Lens ranked #1 among sponsored Lenses.

nodes.interactive-filter.sections.1.item.text: Shaped the filter concepts: Researched competitor filters and helped develop two gesture-based ideas: releasing a sky lantern for TikTok and Snapchat, and a lion-mask transformation for a new character on TikTok. I wrote the creative briefs and reviewed each iteration with TikTok’s effects team.
Briefed creators: Turned each filter into simple video ideas for cosplay, beauty, pet, dance and transition creators, so their posts inspired players to make their own.
Supported creator activation: Reviewed creator selection and content for 70+ creators across TikTok and Snapchat, whose videos went live in the first week to kick off the trend.

nodes.landing-page.summary.en.text: For a major Genshin Impact update, I helped turn the launch landing page from an information page into a game: a short personality quiz with shareable results and a reward draw. It drew 9.5M+ unique visitors and 1.8M+ players into the draw, and converted 3x better than benchmark.

nodes.landing-page.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Researched formats: Studied interactive web campaigns, from quizzes and recaps to referral and reward pages, to find a format that could do more than list what’s new.

nodes.landing-page.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Designed the quiz: Developed an MBTI-style quiz built on scenes from the new region, then cut it to three questions and eight results so fewer players dropped off. The quiz became the heart of the page, linked to the rewards and the download button.

nodes.landing-page.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Built the sharing loop: Shaped the result cards and the reward draw, so finishing the quiz earned a draw and inviting friends earned more. Sharing became the natural next step after getting a result, and each share brought in about 4 visitors, twice the target.
